verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows Yubico documenting a lockout-recovery strategy: no vendor guidance on registering a backup key, and no explanation of what can and cannot be recovered after a key is lost. The only related material is non-exportable key generation (an adjacent property, not recovery guidance) and community users describing their own redundant-key practices (a user-side workaround), and neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor documents a credible lockout-recovery strategy — registering a backup key, and what is and is not recoverable if a key is lost
